excerpts.title: regarding_my_newly_discovered_alterhumanity
excerpts.text: I am aware that elaborating on my nonhuman perception of myself will make others less inclined to take me seriously, to take me at my word. I do not care. I wish to be honest. I wish to make others feel less alone. Therefore what others think of me is irrelevant.
